purpose: Teach: 北九州/日光/アフガン/モロッコ/ナポレオン/富士通/早稲田大学/京都大学

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが北九州出身の作家の本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is reading a book by an author from Kitakyushu, apparently.
lines.style: Soft, sharing-a-discovery tone. Gentle warmth toward Sho. Unhurried pacing. A small lift at the end—offering the fact like a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと日光に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to Nikko with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, earnest appeal. Direct eye contact. Quick tempo, eager but not demanding. The simple clarity of what a six-year-old wants.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアフガン支援の本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me a book about Afghanistan aid work.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in the voice. Noticing something good about him. Gentle, almost confiding. Slight pause before speaking, like she's processing the kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとモロッコの料理食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ate Moroccan food with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, almost proud report. Quick and warm. A small child sharing something he did with someone he loves. Natural excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがナポレオンの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you a picture book about Napoleon.
lines.style: Tender anticipation. Softly delighted. Like she's imagining him doing it and it pleases her. Slight warmth on 'picture book'—she knows Sho will like it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの会社が富士通と取引してるって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard Dad's company does business with Fujitsu!
lines.style: Proud discovery. Eager to share something he's learned about his father. Quick energy, genuine interest. A moment of admiration breaking through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが早稲田大学の卒業生なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is a Waseda graduate.
lines.style: Stating a fact with quiet pride. Warm regard underneath. Slight pause before speaking, as if honoring the information. Steady, clear tempo.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、京都大学に憧れてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really admire Kyoto University.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine aspiration. Shy but serious—testing how it sounds to say aloud. Slower pace. No bravado, just honest dreaming.
